listings.name: Coburg Farmers Market
listings.description: Weekly Saturday farmers' market run by the not-for-profit Melbourne Farmers Markets at a primary school in Coburg.
listings.caveats: Postcode 3058 is not on the source page; added from general knowledge of the suburb, please verify. Holiday closures not checked.

listings.name: Carlton Farmers Market
listings.address: Carlton North Primary School, O'Grady Street entrance
listings.description: Weekly Saturday farmers' market run by Melbourne Farmers Markets at a primary school in Carlton North.
listings.caveats: Source gives school name and entrance but no street number. Postcode 3054 not on source; verify. Listed as 'Carlton' on the organiser's site but the venue is in Carlton North.

listings.name: Alphington Farmers Market
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Sunday from 9am to 1pm, held at the organiser's headquarters
listings.description: Weekly Sunday farmers' market held at the Melbourne Farmers Markets headquarters in Alphington.
listings.caveats: Postcode 3078 is not on the source page; verify.

listings.name: Castlemaine Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Fresh, seasonal produce from the Castlemaine and central Victorian region; food trucks and coffee at the Sunday market

hours.note: Wednesday market is weekly; the Sunday market is held on the first Sunday of each month only.

listings.hoursAsStated: Weekly market every Wednesday afternoon 2.30pm to 5.30pm; monthly market first Sunday of the month 9am to 1pm
listings.description: Two-part farmers' market in Castlemaine: a weekly Wednesday afternoon market and a larger monthly Sunday market.
listings.caveats: Venue address not found on the pages opened (a search snippet suggested Western Reserve, Forest Street; unconfirmed). Postcode 3450 is from general knowledge. Confirm venue.

listings.name: Golden Plains Farmers' Market
listings.address: Corner Milton Street and High Street
listings.otherProducts: Wines, spirits, artisan breads, spices, sauces, gourmet snacks, handmade gifts

hours.note: Held on the first Saturday of each month, excluding January and December.

listings.hoursAsStated: First Saturday of each month (except January and December), 9am to 1pm
listings.description: Monthly farmers' market run by Golden Plains Shire Council in Bannockburn, about 30 minutes north of Geelong.
listings.caveats: Postcode 3331 taken from the council's own contact details for Bannockburn. The council page also mentions a separate Twilight Market; not included. 'weekly' kind is used for the weekday only; real pattern is monthly.

listings.name: Rocky Creek Strawberry Farm
listings.otherProducts: Pick-your-own strawberries, blueberries, raspberries and blackberries; farm gate strawberries and jam berries; cafe and farm shop

hours.note: Seasonal: open 7 days during the season. Closed Christmas Day, New Year's Day and Good Friday. U-pick may close temporarily for weather or when fields are picked out.

listings.hoursAsStated: Open 7 days, 10am to 5pm, excluding Christmas Day, New Year's Day and Good Friday
listings.description: Mornington Peninsula berry farm offering pick-your-own berries, a farm gate stall and a cafe, open daily during the season.
listings.caveats: Season end date not stated on the page opened (third-party listings suggest it runs to about April/May with reduced winter hours). Check before visiting out of season.

listings.name: Hill & Ridge Community Market
listings.address: Red Hill Recreation Reserve & Showgrounds, 184 Arthurs Seat Road
listings.otherProducts: Local produce, artisan makers, gourmet food, art, vintage items (a mixed community market, not only farm produce)

hours.note: First Saturday of each month, September to May. 2026/27 dates listed: 5 Sep, 3 Oct, 7 Nov, 5 Dec, 2 Jan, 6 Feb, 27 Mar (Twilight, Easter Saturday), 3 Apr, 1 May. Times (9am–2pm) are from a council listing; check before you go.

listings.hoursAsStated: Opens first Saturday of each month September to May; the page opened did not state times (a council listing seen only in search results said 9am to 2pm)
listings.description: Monthly community market at the Red Hill showgrounds on the Mornington Peninsula with local produce among its stalls.
listings.caveats: 9am-2pm comes from a search snippet of the Mornington Peninsula Shire listing, not from a page opened. The Twilight date (27 March) likely has different hours. Mixed market; confirm farm-direct stalls.

listings.name: Harvest Launceston Community Farmers' Market
listings.otherProducts: Tasmanian growers and makers; stallholders include pasture-raised lamb, biltong, olives, dairy-free milks and drinks
listings.description: Weekly Saturday market in a Launceston car park featuring Tasmanian growers, producers and makers.
listings.caveats: Postcode 7250 is not on the page; verify. Lamb is one stallholder's product, not the whole market.

listings.name: Farm Gate Market
listings.address: Bathurst Street, between Murray and Elizabeth Streets
listings.otherProducts: Seasonal Tasmanian fresh produce, artisan foods and street food; the market's stated rule is that stallholders grow, make or produce what they sell
listings.description: Weekly Sunday farmers' market that takes over a block of Bathurst Street in central Hobart, known locally as Farmy.
listings.caveats: Official site gives the street block but no street number (a search snippet said 104 Bathurst Street; not confirmed). Postcode 7000 not on the page; verify.

listings.name: Bream Creek Farmers Market
listings.address: Bream Creek Showgrounds, Marion Bay Road
listings.otherProducts: Produce from south-eastern Tasmanian growers, cooks, brewers and makers

hours.note: First Sunday of every month. Winter markets run 9am to 12 noon. 6 December 2026 is a Christmas Special Market.

listings.hoursAsStated: First Sunday of every month, 9am to 1pm
listings.description: Volunteer-run monthly farmers' market at the Bream Creek showgrounds, about 40 minutes from Hobart.
listings.caveats: Site gives venue and directions but no street number (search snippets said 138 Marion Bay Road; not confirmed). Postcode 7175 is from general knowledge; verify. Next date in December per site.

unverified.name: Collingwood Children's Farm Farmers' Market
unverified.why: Third-party listings say second Saturday of the month 8am-1pm, but the farm's own site pages I opened did not mention the market, and the Melbourne Farmers Markets site lists only Coburg, Carlton and Alphington.
